summary: First full-stack test run for CONTINUUM. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass (auth demo/me/logout, all data endpoints incl. overview, students filters/pagination, students/{id}, signals filters, signals/{id}, reviews list/detail, analytics, courses list/detail, data-sources, audit-log, settings, search, POST /signals/{id}/explain LLM non-accusatory, PATCH /signals/{id} + audit, POST /reviews/{id}/notes, POST /reviews/{id}/action with all mappings, PATCH /settings/thresholds, POST /demo/reset). Frontend Playwright: Enter Demo button lands on /dashboard, KPIs 2,481/37/12/8 render, 'Signals Requiring Attention' shows Arjun Kumar, Behavioral Signals Over Time chart rendered, all 9 sidebar nav links route correctly (Overview/Students/Risk Signals/Reviews/Analytics/Courses/Data Sources/Audit Log/Settings), global search returns Arjun and navigates to profile, student profile shows all longitudinal sections (Semester timeline, Writing, Submission, Signals, Baseline), signal detail 'Why am I seeing this?' factors + evidence ledger + explanation text visible + status select updates, review workspace: note save + Acknowledge action fires, audit log reflects new events, theme toggle switches dark<->light. LLM explanation is stored and non-accusatory (verified no 'cheater/guilty/AI-generated/plagiarist/cheating' substrings).

issues: Recharts logs repeated console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' during initial mount — cosmetic only, charts render correctly after ResponsiveContainer measures the parent. Consider setting minHeight/minWidth on ResponsiveContainer wrappers to suppress.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit min height (purely cosmetic; no functional impact).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/auth/demo does not verify caller identity — acceptable for investor demo but should be flagged for prod (rate-limit or gate behind ENV flag).
server.py signal PATCH accepts any string for status without validation against an allowed set; should validate against enum {New, Under Review, Needs Follow-up, Dismissed}.
server.py update_thresholds accepts arbitrary body without pydantic validation — safe here (demo) but should be typed.
server.py: two @app.on_event handlers use the deprecated FastAPI startup/shutdown API (use lifespan context in production).
seed_data.build_all is invoked on startup only if collection is empty; ensure_seed cleanup is not idempotent on partial seeds (only reseeds when count==0). Acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: Demo login via POST /api/auth/demo — no credentials needed. Frontend: click data-testid='enter-demo-button'.
seed_data_creation: Not required — seed_data.py auto-seeds 112 students, 38 signals, 5 semesters, 10 courses on startup. Verified via /api/students total>=100 and Arjun Kumar (STU-2024-1001, SIG-4001, REV-7001) accessible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 21 tests, ~9s runtime, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). LLM /explain endpoint persists explanation on the signal doc, so subsequent 'Generate explanation' UI clicks may not appear (button hidden when text already exists). To re-test full LLM flow, either use a fresh signal id or POST /api/demo/reset first. Hero flow: STU-2024-1001 (Arjun Kumar) via /api/search?q=arjun, SIG-4001, REV-7001.
